title: Hybrid Meta-Heuristic Algorithm for Efficient Resource Allocation in Cloud Computing
abstract: In today’s information driven society cloud computing plays an important role in supporting various services such as E-Commerce platforms, Online Education, Mobile Applications etc. These services should respond quickly to users with minimal operational cost and energy consumption. But achieving this is challenging because cloud resources need to be shared among several tasks, workloads keep changing constantly making it difficult in allocating resources efficiently. Traditional methods for allocating resources efficiently are fast but not accurate they are not able to handle frequent changes in workload. HMAA Hybrid Meta Heuristic Allocation Algorithms is an intelligent method which allocates resources efficiently. The research paper discusses the HMAA algorithm, how it works and the experiments using CloudSim Plus show that HMAA performs better than traditional algorithms. The results show that HMAA provides faster response, higher throughput and provides better energy efficiency making it a promising solution for managing resources.
